posts.title: Introducing Cloud & Code Oost, a new Microsoft meetup in the east of the Netherlands
posts.description: In my MVP renewal post I mentioned that I was making plans to start a meetup of my own. Well, here it is! Together with Hans Muns I’m starting Cloud & Code Oost, a meetup for developers in the east of the Netherlands who work with .NET, Azure and AI. If you live in the east and want to go to a meetup, you usually end up in the car to Utrecht or Amsterdam.

posts.title: I've been renewed as a Microsoft MVP in 2026 🥳!
